practice.title: Self-practice
practice.lead: Put the reference video next to your own camera mirror, compare and tick each parameter yourself. No AI scoring yet.
practice.session.title: Practise a sign
practice.privacy.title: The camera is only your mirror
practice.privacy.body: The camera starts only when you choose. No recording, no audio capture, no images sent anywhere. There is no AI scoring; you assess yourself and save only your checklist choices in this browser.
practice.collection.title: Your video collection
practice.collection.notice: You supplied these videos; they have not been reviewed by a VSL expert. English translations are provisional and syllabus mapping is pending.
practice.collection.unassigned: This collection video has not been assigned to a syllabus lesson.
practice.filter.label: Filter signs to practise
practice.empty.title: No matching signs yet
practice.empty.body: Choose All, add a favorite or view a sign in a lesson, then come back.
practice.empty.content: No signs are available for self-practice yet.
practice.video.title: Reference video
practice.video.label: Sign video: {word}
practice.camera.title: Your mirror
practice.camera.label: Your camera mirror
practice.camera.off.title: Camera is off
practice.camera.privacy: Turn on the camera to see yourself as in a mirror. Images stay here and are not recorded or sent anywhere.
practice.camera.off: Camera is off. You can also practise in front of a physical mirror and assess yourself below.
practice.camera.pending: Waiting for camera permission from your browser. You can cancel and use a physical mirror.
practice.camera.timeout: The camera has not responded. Check the permission dialog or choose Turn on camera to try again; self-assessment is still available below.
practice.camera.denied: Camera permission was denied. Open the lock or site-permissions icon beside the address bar, allow the camera and try again. You can still use a physical mirror.
practice.camera.missing: No suitable camera was found. Check its connection and try again, or use a physical mirror and assess yourself.
practice.camera.busy: The camera could not start; another app may be using it. Close that app and try again. Self-assessment is still available.
practice.camera.unsupported: This browser cannot open the camera. Use a recent Chrome or Edge, or practise with a physical mirror and assess yourself.
practice.camera.insecure: The camera needs HTTPS or localhost/127.0.0.1. Open a suitable address, or use a physical mirror and assess yourself.
practice.camera.error: The camera mirror could not start. Check the camera and its permissions, then try again; self-assessment remains available.
practice.camera.ended: The camera disconnected. Reconnect and choose Turn on camera, or continue with a physical mirror.
practice.no_js: Enable JavaScript to use the camera mirror, countdown and saved practice history. You can still read the content and use the checklist with a physical mirror.
practice.assessment.title: Assess this attempt yourself
practice.assessment.note: Compare with the reference video or a physical mirror. This is your own assessment, not an automatic score.
practice.assessment.legend: Tick the aspects you feel you achieved
practice.saved: Practice saved: you ticked {n}/5 aspects. The checklist has been reset.
practice.retry.ready: Checklist and countdown reset. You can start another attempt.
practice.history.title: History for this sign
practice.history.note: Up to 10 recent attempts, newest first. Only the time and your checklist choices are saved.
practice.history.requires_js: History appears when JavaScript is enabled.
practice.history.empty: No practice attempts for this sign yet.
